gaps.quote: since the coefficient error is below $1/2$
gaps.note: The page asserts that the coefficient error is below 1/2 but never gives the error bound, its source, or why it holds for the chosen parameters. The reader cannot check the exact recovery from what the page gives.

gaps.term: Uniform strict power gap over all tape procedures
gaps.quote: the parameters are chosen so that this strict gap survives every layer and every level of recursion
gaps.note: The page claims every tape procedure costs a power u^tau of its width and that the parameters preserve this gap across all layers and recursion levels, but it does not state the parameter choice, nor why each procedure reduces to the cited swap cost.

gaps.quote: Summing the layers gives $O(V(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$ tape operations in total, with stored volume $V=\Theta(n)$.
gaps.note: The total is presented as the sum over layers, but the page gives neither the per-layer costs nor the summation, and does not justify V = Theta(n) for the stored volume.

gaps.term: From tape operations to running time
gaps.quote: Since the reduction is exact, this gives the stated time $O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$.
gaps.note: Exactness of the reduction shows correctness, not running time. The page never says how the count of tape operations translates into machine steps or time, so the stated time does not follow from what the page gives.
